messages:
incident-bot: PAGER open — SRV lookup failures detected for internal service discovery (CoreDNS) in us-west-2a. Alert: elevated srv_failures rate >= 5% for 5m across control plane. Pager: oncall-sre-kai
oncall-sre-kai: taking this. pinging netops. pulling logs now.
oncall-sre-kai: kubectl --context prod-uswest2a -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=coredns
oncall-sre-kai: coredns-0 CrashLoopBackOff, coredns-1 Running
maria-eng-runtime: seeing many `srv lookup failed` from runtime logs 10.1.2.x -> coreDNS cluster IP
netops-liz: infra telemetry shows partial network flap to nodes in az us-west-2a starting at 2425301100; BGP route withdraws for node subnet for ~5m
oncall-sre-kai: hypothesis: node-level networking causing some coredns pods to be partitioned -> SRV fails
oncall-sre-kai: mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain affected nodes with failing coredns pod, 2) scale up coredns to 4 replicas with podAntiAffinity relaxed, 3) enable fallback to consul if coredns not responding
eng-platform-chen: rolling a emergency coredns patch to prefer endpoints on healthy nodes. pushing now.
oncall-sre-kai: commands:
```
kubectl -n kube-system cordon ip-10-0-7-45
kubectl -n kube-system drain ip-10-0-7-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl -n kube-system scale deploy/coredns --replicas=4
```
maria-eng-runtime: adding quick runtime-side fallback: increase SRV cache ttl to 30s and enable client-side retry 3x with 200ms backoff. Pushing config to runtime env.
netops-liz: confirmed BGP withdraws correlated to a fabric switch flapping in us-west-2a; vendor is engaged, ETA 20m for fix.
oncall-sre-kai: after scaling, seeing 2/4 coredns healthy. srv failure rate down from 6.2% -> 0.9% over last 3 min. 🎉 :thumbsup:
cs-lead-jorge: CS report: three enterprise customers reported internal errors to their services, highest impact between 12:15-12:34 UTC. I've opened support tickets and advised retries.
oncall-sre-kai: temporary mitigation still in place. marking incident as 'mitigated'. preparing handoff to netops team for vendor follow-through. will run postmortem.
eng-platform-chen: can we set a routing fallback so cross-az traffic avoids affected node subnets for 1h? netops-liz working on a route pin to healthy egress.
netops-liz: added static prefer-route to us-west-2b for control-plane traffic. pushing BGP sanity check.
oncall-sre-kai: customer impact summary: internal SRV lookup errors caused 5-10% increased 5xx for service A and B for ~19m. Affected subset of nodes in us-west-2a. No data loss. Severity: Sev2.
pg-team-alex: scheduled rollback window at 13:20 UTC if vendor fix doesn't stabilize.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated -> annotated 'routing fallback & coredns scale up' at 2425301400
oncall-sre-kai: handing off to netops-liz for follow-up with vendor and to eng-platform-chen for durable coredns fix tomorrow. tagging owners.
netops-liz: I'll keep the change live until vendor confirms fabric stable. will post vendor ticket #VND-1129 in this thread.
maria-eng-runtime: adding evals to catch regressions: add SRV synthetic check to alert when srv_fail_rate>1% for 3m. sending PR.
cs-lead-jorge: CS will send incident summary to affected customers with mitigation timeline and suggested retries. assigning follow-ups.
oncall-sre-kai: final note: root cause preliminary: intermittent fabric switch causing node-level network isolation -> partial coredns pod partition -> SRV lookup timeouts. full RCA to follow after vendor logs. @everyone please add any additional context.
netops-liz: vendor confirmed faulty module replaced; awaiting 30m of stable telemetry before closing. :white_check_mark:
oncall-sre-kai: signing off. night oncall: @eng-platform-chen will handle handoff at 13:55 UTC. Thanks all.
